name: Pull Shark
activity: Merged pull requests that you authored
note: The upgraded thresholds come from community observations.

name: Pair Extraordinaire
activity: Merged pull requests containing a commit you genuinely co-authored
note: Use a GitHub-linked email in the commit trailer. The upgraded thresholds come from community observations.

name: Galaxy Brain
activity: Answers accepted in eligible GitHub Discussions
note: The GitHub Community forum is excluded. The upgraded thresholds come from community observations.

name: Starstruck
activity: Stars received on one repository you created
note: The upgraded thresholds come from community observations.

name: Quickdraw
activity: An issue or pull request closed within five minutes of opening
note: GitHub's announcement thread discusses the time window. The linked public example credits an issue.

name: YOLO
activity: A pull request you merged without code review
note: Keep required reviews in place. A qualifying event can occur in a solo project where review is optional.

name: Public Sponsor
note: The GitHub Docs explain sponsorship visibility options.

name: Finishing Touch
activity: Merged pull requests GitHub recognizes as improving its own interface
note: Availability for outside contributors and thresholds are community-reported. Eligibility rules are unpublished.

name: Heart On Your Sleeve
note: GitHub staff reported that the experimental rollout was taken down.

name: Open Sourcerer
note: GitHub staff reported that the experimental rollout was taken down.

name: Arctic Code Vault Contributor
activity: Code in repositories included in the 2020 GitHub Archive Program snapshot
note: The qualifying snapshot has already taken place.

name: Mars 2020 Contributor
activity: Code in qualifying repositories used by the Mars 2020 helicopter mission
note: The award was tied to a past mission.
